title: Messy Data Importer
summary: A messy CSV or PDF export goes in; a clean, normalized spreadsheet with a summary tab comes out.
result: Supplier exports with mixed date, currency and column formats become one consistent table in seconds.

metric.label: from raw supplier export to a clean sheet with a summary tab

note: Demo built with fictitious supplier files designed to reproduce common real-world problems.

screenshots.alt: Before: raw CSV with merged headers, mixed date formats and currency symbols
After: normalized table and summary tab in Google Sheets

upworkBlurb: Data cleaning and import pipeline: messy CSV or PDF exports (merged headers, mixed date formats, currency symbols, duplicated rows, split columns) are parsed, cleaned and normalized into one consistent spreadsheet, with a summary tab and a log of every fix applied. Runs as a Python script or directly in Google Sheets with Apps Script. Demo uses fictitious supplier files. Stack: Python (pandas, pdfplumber), Google Sheets, Apps Script.
